updates.title: SHOWROOM CLIENT // YOUR WARRIOR ON THE RIGHT
items: The launcher no longer uses a battle scene behind the UI.
HOME now mirrors the in-game showroom style with the selected 3D warrior displayed on the right.
The client reads main_menu_shop_state.json and mounts kw.pck to render the real selected warrior and skin.
The left side is reserved for PLAY / UPDATE / profile controls while the character remains unobstructed.

updates.title: LIVE 3D CLIENT // CINEMATIC BATTLE BACKGROUND
items: KW Client is now a Godot-powered 3D application instead of a 2D updater shell.
HOME renders a live slow-motion battle scene with moving camera, 3D warriors, tracers, neon lights, debris and explosions.
PLAY / UPDATE / profile / patch feed remain real client controls over the 3D viewport.
The previous local virtual username is imported when an existing updater config is found.

updates.title: VISUAL CLIENT // KW BATTLE ART PASS
items: The real KW pixel logo is now used inside the client and website.
HOME now has an animated slow-motion Warriors Rift battle background.
Explosion sprite frames, neon energy streaks and drifting debris animate behind PLAY / UPDATE.
Profile avatar now uses in-game pixel art instead of a generic placeholder graphic.

updates.title: VIRTUAL ID // CLIENT PROFILE PASS
items: Virtual usernames now travel through the online authority and snapshots.
Local and remote players display their virtual username above the character.
Duel room player cards now use the virtual username instead of the hero name.
The new KW Client writes a local kw_profile.json and passes the same ID into the game.

updates.title: CLIENT SHELL // VIRTUAL PROFILE PREVIEW
items: New KW-styled client layout with HOME and UPDATES navigation.
Local virtual username and placeholder avatar; no real account system yet.
Virtual username is passed into KW and displayed above players.
Updater still hash-verifies the live build before PLAY unlocks.

updates.title: PERFORMANCE // ONLINE PASS
items: Compact online snapshots and lower network overhead.
MultiMesh batching for combat FX, weapons, arena details and Aevilok wings.
Projectile, grenade, damage, spawn-effect and hostile-bullet pooling.
Remote actor LOD, lighter shadows and lower client/server allocation pressure.

updates.title: SPATIAL COMBAT AUDIO
items: Footsteps, jumps and landings originate from the actual actor.
Weapon shots originate from the muzzle.
Grenade throw, bounce and explosion audio now use real world positions.
